title: Settings
description: Applies to this local Nodestro installation.

language.title: Language
language.label: Interface language
language.automaticHint: Follows your browser's language, currently {{language}}. Unsupported languages show English.
language.hint: Takes effect at once and is remembered, even after a restart.
language.contentNote: The language only changes the interface. Your agents, prompts, workflows and results stay in their original language. New drafts by the AI assistants are written in this language unless you ask for another one.

models.title: Models and budget
models.assistantHint: Designs agents from your description, writes tools and proposes memory.
models.budgetHint: A run stops as soon as the estimated costs exceed the budget. Empty = no limit.
models.architectBudget: Cost limit of the Workflow Architect (USD per draft)
models.architectBudgetHint: The architect stops when a draft costs more. Empty = no limit.
models.architectRepairsHint: How often the architect may ask the AI to fix a configuration or tool draft (0 to 5). Corrections without AI are always made.
models.defaultHint: New agents start with this provider and model.
models.defaultProviderMissing: The default model belongs to {{provider}}, which is not set up.
models.defaultSwitchHint: New agents and example copies cannot run with it. Existing workflows keep their models either way.
models.defaultPickHint: Pick a model of {{providers}} as the default model below.

sandbox.title: Sandbox for your own tools
sandbox.label: Sandbox
sandbox.text: Your own and AI-created tools never run in the Nodestro process. Tools you wrote yourself run in a separate Python process. AI-created tools and tools of unknown origin run only isolated: in Docker once it passed Nodestro's checks, or in the built-in Linux sandbox if you chose it. Without isolation they are blocked; Nodestro never falls back to an unprotected process.
sandbox.dockerUnreachable: Docker cannot be reached. Tool tests and calls fail until Docker is running.

reason.platform: The built-in sandbox needs Linux on a 64-bit Intel or AMD processor.
reason.untested-system: The built-in sandbox is approved only for Ubuntu 24.04 and Debian 13; this system ({{system}}) has not been tested. Use Docker for AI-created tools.
reason.landlock: The Linux kernel lacks Landlock (version 4 or newer), which the built-in sandbox needs. Update the system or use Docker.
reason.seccomp: The Linux kernel lacks seccomp, which the built-in sandbox needs. Use Docker.
reason.root: Nodestro runs as the administrator (root). Start it as a normal user to use the built-in sandbox.
reason.paths: Nodestro is installed inside a protected folder (for example directly in your home folder or the data folder). Move the app to its own folder.
reason.verify: The self-test of the built-in sandbox failed: the isolation did not hold. AI-created tools stay blocked; use Docker.
reason.failed: The self-test of the built-in sandbox could not run. AI-created tools stay blocked; use Docker.

modeHint.auto: Automatic (recommended): AI-created tools run only in Docker, once it passed Nodestro's checks; otherwise they are blocked. The built-in Linux sandbox is never chosen automatically. Your own tools run in a separate Python process.
modeHint.linux: Linux sandbox (optional, Linux only): AI-created tools run in Nodestro's built-in Linux sandbox instead of Docker, but without third-party Python packages; tools that need such packages are blocked. It is used only when you choose it.
modeHint.subprocess: Python process (trusted use only): your own tools run in a separate process. AI-created tools and tools of unknown origin are always blocked; neither Docker nor the built-in Linux sandbox is used.
modeHint.docker: Docker: every tool, also your own, runs in a container. If Docker is not running, no tool runs.

sandbox.containersOnly: On this server, every tool runs in a container. The sandbox cannot be changed here.
sandbox.runtimeHint: The computer where the Nodestro runtime runs, not the device of this browser.

blocked.auto: AI-created tools are blocked: Automatic runs them only in Docker, and Docker is not running. Install and start Docker; Nodestro then uses it automatically.
blocked.subprocess: AI-created tools are blocked: the Python process is for trusted use only. To run them, choose Automatic and start Docker.
blocked.subprocessLinux: AI-created tools are blocked: the Python process is for trusted use only. To run them, choose Automatic and start Docker, or choose Linux sandbox (without third-party Python packages).
blocked.subprocessChanged: If you chose Python process in an earlier version: it no longer runs AI-created tools in a built-in sandbox, and Nodestro kept your choice instead of switching to Automatic for you.
blocked.linux: AI-created tools are blocked: the built-in Linux sandbox is not available on this computer; its row below says why. To run them in Docker instead, choose Automatic and start Docker.
blocked.dockerRefused: AI-created tools are blocked: they run only in Docker, and Docker did not pass Nodestro's checks.
blocked.checking: AI-created tools are blocked until Nodestro has finished checking Docker.

backendReason.not-released: Implemented and self-tested, but not independently reviewed. Nodestro does not use it.
backendReason.not-implemented: Nodestro has no native sandbox for this operating system yet.
backendReason.removed: Removed: Nodestro uses Docker on macOS.
backendReason.unreachable: Docker is not installed or not running.
backendReason.server: On a server, tool code runs only in containers.
backendReason.platform: Not available on this operating system.

docker.ready: Docker is ready: the engine passed Nodestro's checks.
docker.selfTestHint: Starts a test container with the sandbox's restrictions and checks that they hold. Only administrators can run it.
docker.throttled: Not run: a check ran moments ago, so nothing new was checked. Try again in {{seconds}} s; the results shown are from the last check.
docker.refreshIgnored: Not run: only administrators can start a new check. The results shown are from the last check.
docker.redacted: Technical details are visible to administrators only.
docker.rootfulNote: Members of the docker group are effectively root on this computer. Rootless Docker is recommended.

reason.missing: Docker is not installed. Install Docker or a compatible engine; Nodestro detects it automatically.
reason.unreachable: Docker is installed but not running or cannot be reached. Start it and check again.
reason.limits: The engine does not enforce memory, process and CPU limits. Nodestro needs cgroup v2 limits and does not use this engine.
reason.seccomp: The engine does not apply a system call filter (seccomp). Nodestro does not use this engine.
reason.rootless-cgroup: Rootless Docker cannot enforce limits here: cgroup v2 delegation of the cpu, memory and pids controllers is missing.
reason.os-type: The engine runs Windows containers. Switch it to Linux containers.
reason.selftest: The test container failed Nodestro's checks, so the engine is not used.
reason.image: The sandbox image is missing or does not match this version. Prepare the sandbox.

about.title: About Nodestro
about.data: All data is stored locally in an SQLite database (default: ~/.nodestro, changeable with NODESTRO_DATA_DIR).

ocr.title: Text recognition (OCR)
ocr.text: Recognizes text in scanned PDFs locally with Tesseract. No data is sent anywhere. Uncertain words are marked.
ocr.label: Use OCR for scans
ocr.available: OCR ready: Tesseract, language data and Poppler found
ocr.missing: Not available: needs Tesseract with language data and pdftoppm and pdfinfo (Poppler)

providers.title: AI providers
providers.intro: Nodestro works with several providers at the same time. Each agent uses the provider of its model; nothing switches to another provider on its own.
providers.fromEnvironment: The key comes from the environment variable {{variable}}; a key stored here is not used then.
providers.keyStored: A key is stored. It is never shown and is sent only to this provider.
providers.keyMissing: No key yet. Enter it here or set {{variables}}.
providers.baseUrlDefault: Usually {{url}} for a local server. The provider counts as set up once a base URL is saved.
providers.baseUrlHint: The address of the OpenAI-compatible API, for example https://example.com/v1.
providers.capabilitiesHint: Nodestro assumes nothing about your own servers: options a model cannot do, or that are unknown, are reported as errors instead of being left out.
providers.defaultFollowed: New agents now use {{model}} ({{provider}}). Existing workflows keep their models; you can change this under Models.
